newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta ends stronger, supported by dollar.
newsitem.headline: Peseta ends stronger, supported by dollar.

text.p: The peseta ended stronger, well supported by a higher dollar which hit a 34-month peak against the mark.
"I would say it is more mark weakness than peseta strength," said Gregorio Gomez at All Trading in Madrid.
At around 1700 GMT, the peseta was trading at 84.57/60 per mark, versus an opening level at around 84.78/81 and Monday's close at 84.87/88.
The peseta was trading at its highest level in a week.
But traders added that outside Spain, attention was focused on February German unemployment data due on Thursday.
Domestically, attention was directed at labour reform talks, which reopened at around 1530 GMT and could produce a deal between employers and trade unions. -- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
